scope: Valid-only common full-field comparison of frozen Heat3D V6 and Therm-FM cohorts

heat3d.selection_policy: historical V6 valid_iid selection; no P23 reselection
heat3d.full_field_mapping: existing V6 deterministic full-field utility; mapping must be audited before execution

therm_fm.selection_policy: upstream normalized-loss selection; no physical-metric reselection
therm_fm.input_representation: dense 741-channel case-definition raster on native 65x65 grid

metrics.point_global_relative_rmse_pct: 100 * sqrt(sum_{s,i}(pred_{si}-truth_{si})^2 / sum_{s,i} truth_{si}^2); unit node weights
metrics.true_hotspot_region_rmse_K: sqrt(mean over nodes in frozen top-1-percent-by-T_true region of squared error)

hotspot_definition.rule: top 1 percent nodes by T_true within each sample

metrics.seed_dispersion: mean plus SD across three training seeds; 3x128 rows are not 384 independent replicates

paired_bootstrap.pairing: same valid case after averaging the three frozen seed predictions within each model
paired_bootstrap.interpretation: conditional on the frozen three-seed cohort; no seed-level t-test or post-hoc significance fishing

condition_stratification.bin_rule: valid-case input-only quantiles Q0-Q33, Q33-Q67, Q67-Q100; edges frozen before joining any model error

table_B.title: P1i full-field transfer comparison
table_B.pretraining_qualifier: Therm-FM is pretrained transfer; not same-information-budget

checkpoint_policy.heat3d: fixed frozen V6 identity; no P23 selection
checkpoint_policy.therm_fm: minimum valid normalized loss; report physical metrics at that checkpoint
checkpoint_policy.best_to_best: not a new P23 policy; do not relabel different selection objectives as equivalent
checkpoint_policy.final_sensitivity: may be reported separately when artifacts are available
